The base can move the carton in small increments. I’m watching its position closely as I clear it from the refrigerator door.
The open door is blocking the recovery path. I’m moving it partly closed from above, then I can approach the carton from the clear side.
The arm is getting caught across the door’s top edge. I’m approaching its outer face so I can close it with a direct push.
The door is now partly closed and the approach is clear. I’m returning to the carton for the final recovery attempt.
The carton is still on the floor. The arm’s joint limits prevent a direct pickup from this height, so I’m checking one last recovery approach with the mobile base.
The base has moved the carton closer to the coffee counter, but it remains on the floor. I’m making a short final adjustment, then I’ll withdraw and inspect the final state.
The coffee is still upright, and the gripper is clear of both items. The milk remains on the floor at the base of the counter; I couldn’t recover it onto the countertop. I’m stopping further motion.

Stopped with the gripper clear. The sugar appears to be inside the coffee, but the milk remains on the floor beside the counter, so the task is incomplete.

Controller saved at [gen.py](/app/output/gen.py).
